description: Confirm a file has been uploaded to its signed URL and trigger automatic sample generation (drafts only). Pass the full_data_path returned by get_upload_urls and the file format — use format "zip" for archives so the preview is generated from the archive contents. Poll get_listing_status until the sample is ready before publishing.

format.description: Format of the uploaded file. Strongly recommended — the upload path has no extension.

name: confirm_upload
